data.short_meaning: New creation or born of new
data.long_meaning: The name Naushazaad is derived from Persian words 'Nau' meaning new and 'Shazad' meaning prince or born of noble. It signifies a new creation or a noble birth. The name Naushazaad carries the meaning “New creation or born of new” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu. Parents who choose Naushazaad usually hope their child will grow to embody new creation or born of new and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, the name signifies a fresh start or a new beginning, aligning with the concept of a believer being born again through faith.
data.etymology: Naushazaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “New creation or born of new.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naushazaad total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
